name: MonarchLogoCloud
title: LogoCloud
wrapsNative: MonarchFlowLayout centred for the row, LazyVGrid with adaptive GridItems for the grid, Link for logos with a destination
summary: The organisations a product can name (customers, partners, integrations) as a titled, centred row or a grid of logos, with the name as a wordmark when there is no image.
whenToUse: On an about, welcome or integrations screen that shows organisations you have permission to name.
whenNotToUse: For the organisations a signed-in person belongs to, use a List with MonarchAvatar rows. For integrations people can open and configure, use MonarchConnectedAppsList.
api: init(title: String? = nil, logos: [MonarchLogoCloudLogo], layout: MonarchLogoCloudLayout = .row, size: MonarchLogoCloudSize = .md, isMonochrome: Bool = true, listLabel: String? = nil)
MonarchLogoCloudLogo.init(_ name: String, image: Image? = nil, destination: URL? = nil)
enum MonarchLogoCloudSize { case sm, md, lg }

options.name: title
options.description: A short line above the logos, shown in small capitals; also the spoken name of the cloud.

options.name: logos
options.description: The organisations in display order: the name, an optional Image and an optional destination.

options.name: layout
options.description: A centred wrapping row, or a grid of bordered cells at least 144 points wide.

options.name: size
options.description: The height of logo images, 24, 32 or 44 points (scaled with Dynamic Type), and the size of wordmarks.

options.name: isMonochrome
options.description: Draws images as templates in the muted text colour.

options.name: listLabel
options.description: Replaces the built-in spoken name "Organisations" used when there is no title.

states.name: row
states.description: Logos wrap onto centred rows with 24 points between them.

states.name: grid
states.description: Equal cells with a subtle border, as many per row as fit.

states.name: wordmark
states.description: A logo without an image shows the name in semibold muted text.

states.name: linked
states.description: A logo with a destination is a Link, at least 44 points tall.

appearance: The title is a caption in small capitals in the muted text colour; wordmarks and monochrome images use the muted text colour; grid cells have the subtle border. Colours come from theme roles in every theme.
platformNotes: The web LogoCloud also swaps in a dark-theme image through <picture> and restores colour on hover. On iOS the app passes the Image (an asset with light and dark appearances covers the dark logo), there is no hover, and a URL image is loaded by the app. Links open with the system, as every Link does. Android does not ship this component.
accessibility: The cloud is a container named by its title, or "Organisations" without one.
Each logo is one element read as the organisation's name, whether it shows an image or a wordmark.
A logo with a destination is a link and is at least 44 points tall.
The title has the header trait.
edgeCases: Long names wrap inside their row or cell.
Two logos with the same name share an identity; give each organisation a distinct name.
Images keep their aspect ratio at the size's height; a very wide image takes a row of its own.

examples.title: Wordmarks in a row
examples.code:
MonarchLogoCloud(
    title: "Placeholder organisations",
    logos: [
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company A"),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company B"),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company C"),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company D"),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company E"),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company F"),
    ]
)

examples.title: Grid with links
examples.code:
MonarchLogoCloud(
    title: "Integrations",
    logos: [
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company A", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/integrations/1")),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company B", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/integrations/2")),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company C", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/integrations/3")),
        MonarchLogoCloudLogo("Company D", destination: URL(string: "https://example.com/integrations/4")),
    ],
    layout: .grid,
    size: .sm
)
